needs_atom.missing: 'Activate only once each turn.': no activation-count limit. ActivatedAbility carries only a condition and a timing window (SORCERY/INSTANT); no FAtomPred or QThisTurn kind counts how often this ability was activated this turn, and the engine has no per-turn activation limit outside loyalty abilities (CostLoyalty). Without it the {1}{G}: +2/+2 until end of turn pump repeats (stronger than printed).
